user.title: Set up Rain Director
user.description: Enter the IP address and port of the EW11A RS485-to-WiFi bridge wired to the Rain Director's bus, and the volume of your loft tank. The integration connects to the bridge over a persistent TCP connection, the same way `nc` would from a terminal, and stays connected.

data_description.tank_litres: Usable volume in litres between 0% and 100% on the level sensor (100 for a standard Rain Director header tank). Used to turn level changes into litres for the water counters. You can change it later with Reconfigure; it only affects water counted from then on.

reconfigure.title: Update Rain Director connection
reconfigure.description: Change the EW11A bridge's IP address and port (e.g. after replacing a failed one) and/or the loft tank volume. Existing entities, history, water totals and dashboard references are kept.

data_description.tank_litres: Usable volume in litres between 0% and 100% on the level sensor. Changing it only affects water counted from now on; totals already recorded are not rewritten. The bridge is only test-connected if the host or port changed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a TCP connection to that host/port.
error.no_traffic: Connected, but no bus traffic arrived within a few seconds. Check this is the EW11A's data port and that the bus is powered.
